newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF T-bill, 10-yr JGB offers likely in Jan-traders.
newsitem.headline: MOF T-bill, 10-yr JGB offers likely in Jan-traders.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) is likely to offer six-month Treasury bills on January 8 and 10-year bonds on January 9, both through price-competitive auctions, traders said on Monday.
The size of the T-bill offer is expected to be about 1.5 trillion yen, as 1.5 trillion yen worth of six-month Treasury bills are due on January 13, they said.
Japan's capital market closes for New Year holidays on Monday and will reopen on January 6.
